programs.title: I Was Prey: Blood in the Water
programs.desc: A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains  miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert's Python Swim
programs.desc: Robert gets in the water with Gloria, a 12-foot reticulated python, to swim alongside her for the first time in the Crocoseum  Bindi welcomes home two orphaned kangaroo joeys  Terri helps release a rescued wedge-tailed eagle back into the wild.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Twin Tops
programs.desc: Shaun flies from treetop to treetop in an attempt to rescue indoor cat, Simon  unpredictable, repeat offender Malcolm must be rescued once again.

programs.title: The Zoo
programs.desc: When Matthew the feisty camel develops a tooth issue, the zoo staff is determined to treat him  Ivy the babirusa is expecting for the very first time  one keeper builds a bond with a Magellanic penguin chick reluctant to be hand-fed.

programs.title: Mystery of the Black Demon Shark
programs.desc: In Mexico, legends swirl around El Demonio Negro, a 50-foot shark that has terrorized fishermen and tourists alike for generations  Forrest Galante hunts for answers in the most rugged and remote parts of the Baja Peninsula.

programs.title: The Zoo
programs.desc: A 14-year-old otter is not its usual, energetic self  staff at the New York Aquarium move their sharks to a new exhibit  quirky capercaillies need help producing healthy chicks.
